method: introspection of the exported values of every D2 contract module, not grep-and-read

declared_kinds_only: obvious support of the paraphrased principle

gap5.note: the A1 token names exist in D2A1_TOKENS, but a token NAME is not an anchor: without meanings the measurement contract cannot be rendered state-blind

conclusion: A1 was NOT executable as preregistered; the round freezes the prerequisites and makes zero calls rather than writing stimuli, an answer key, an instrument and a failure rule at execution time
section_4_mechanism_note: A1 does NOT remove the canonical credence from the request — it must stay, or the HIGH/LOW manipulation would not exist. A1 removes the measurement-side numeric shortcut: D2A1_LEXICAL_LAWS already forbids a credence number, a mapping hint, arm words, the canonical proposition, action tokens and any 4-gram shared with the canonical label in the CONTRACT.
section_6_scope_note: the paraphrase literal is byte-identical to D2A1_PARAPHRASE and the claim scope stays narrowed: a positive licenses CANONICAL_BELIEF_PROPOSITION_SEMANTICALLY_LEGIBLE_ON_PREREGISTERED_PARAPHRASE only, and a null may not be widened to global proposition unreadability
